name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw no paid activity across Meta or Google Ads in the last 28 days, making Google Business Profile the sole lead source with 98 total actions (12 calls, 49 directions, 37 web clicks). The biggest concern is a 54.55% drop in Search Console clicks over the past 7 days versus the prior 7, likely signaling a rankings dip or seasonal pullback in organic search demand.
